'''Bryyn Woolery''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who owned a business in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] settlement on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
A [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] native, Bryyn Woolery owned a business in the [[City/Legends|city]] of Mos Espa. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her previous owner, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]], Woolery acquired the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] girl [[Melee/Legends|Melee]]. Putting her to work maintaining the machinery within his shop for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Woolery eventually relocated his business to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], in search of a more lucrative market. The move proved to be a good one, for his business soon flourished. While he eventually freed Melee, he employed her as a paid assistant.<ref name="db" />
